LibreOffice 26.2.4 for macOS arm64 is redistributed unmodified as an isolated
document-to-PDF process. The upstream disk image is fixed by SHA-256 in
third_party/documents/sources.lock.json.

LibreOffice is made available under MPL-2.0 and LGPLv3+ terms, with bundled
third-party components under their respective notices. The component build
copies the complete upstream Resources/LICENSE, Resources/LICENSE.html, and
Resources/NOTICE files from the fixed disk image into the generated bundle.

Upstream project: https://www.libreoffice.org/
Source and license information: https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/licenses/
